description: This file defines the SettingsTab view component for an iOS application, handling user interface elements and logic for app settings such as gateway configuration, device features, and security options.

classes.name: SettingsTab
classes.description: A SwiftUI View struct managing the settings interface, including gateway connection, device features, and onboarding controls.

methods.name: gatewayDebugText
methods.description: Generates a diagnostic string summarizing gateway connection status and logs.

methods.name: applySetupCodeAndConnect
methods.description: Applying setup code and initiating connection process to the specified gateway host and port.

methods.name: applySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes and applies a setup code, updating configuration and credentials as needed.

methods.name: applySetupURL
methods.description: Parses a URL to extract gateway host and port details, updating manual configuration fields.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a manually specified gateway host and port.

methods.name: resetOnboarding
methods.description: Resets onboarding and gateway credentials, clearing stored data and resetting app state.
